purpose: Capture Android/Termux, Runtime Doctor and Frida readiness evidence without performing dynamic or build mutations.
allowed: read Android release SDK and ABI properties
enumerate Frida device channel with privacy minimization

state_contract.TOKEN_VAZIO_NOT_PHYSICAL_TERMUX: The gate executed outside an Android+Termux-shaped environment. This is valid negative evidence, not a failure of the gate.
state_contract.PHYSICAL_TERMUX_OBSERVED_FRIDA_GAP: Android+Termux was observed but Frida device readiness was not fully observed.
state_contract.PHYSICAL_READINESS_OBSERVED_LIMITED: Android+Termux and Frida device enumeration were observed; attach/hook/patch remain untested.
state_contract.REVIEW_REQUIRED_PROBE_EXIT: A read-only probe returned a non-zero exit and must be inspected before any promotion.

separation_invariants: TOKEN_VAZIO is preserved until direct evidence closes it

privacy.claim_from_hash: forbidden; hashes bind provenance but do not prove identity

physical_next_routes.frida: PHYSICAL_READONLY -> readiness receipt -> explicit authorized OBSERVE only
physical_next_routes.apkc: separate explicit apkc_validate_termux_arm32.sh route; never invoked by PHYSICAL_READONLY
physical_next_routes.vm: separate explicit VM/QEMU route; never invoked by PHYSICAL_READONLY

F_ok: A non-mutating physical evidence contract exists and is separated from build, attach, patch and VM execution.
F_gap: Physical Android/Termux execution has not been observed by this configuration artifact.
F_next: Execute scripts/runtime_doctor_physical_readonly_gate.sh on physical Termux and preserve the exact receipt; close only states directly evidenced by that run.
